scope: Only current-choice-preview.ts, current-choice-read-fence.test.ts and additive lifecycle matcher observation. No new head lookup, product execution or owned-file mutation.

findings.disposition: Adopt source current-choice-preview.ts exactly. Reauthorize the private preferences namespace after external callbacks, then jointly compare case, reviewed result, producer result, and binding through the canonical C08 read fence; return a detached copy of the final observed binding.

findings.disposition: Retain Finance lifecycle code and diagnostics. Add the source combined assessment/entries digest before and after the detached asymmetric matcher. Preserve the existing assessment assertion and every other assertion/timeout. Proposed candidate is d220c42a28e87b034ca3513aca088a0dd0db262b, 42 expect call sites versus 41.

findings.finding: The new read-fence test seeds a conditioned, financially unknown historical choice and private binding. It exercises actual UI admission, SQLite persistence, canonical C08 state provider and result-store reads, but does not calculate or prove a canonical human choice journey.
findings.disposition: Adopt exact source test 46b004a1b374229ad46077930134ba0469213087 and run it together with the real current-choice lifecycle consumer in Actions. Keep native, installed, C/D and overall acceptance open.

unchangedBoundary: No financial formulas or policy changes.
No Planner operations applied by the new fence test.

limitations: Static review is not runtime qualification. Source exact-code intake and the proposed additive lifecycle candidate require affected Actions validation on the published Finance W/S pair.
